independentAudit.limits: An empty/unparseable listing or shared ISC identity is unresolved, not proof of no publication. Audit is bounded to the existing 180-profile roster; withdrawn/untracked communities were not reintroduced. Broader web searches did not establish replacement schedules for unresolved sources.

notes: No paid extraction was used. Native PDF parsing, RapidOCR, source-image inspection and strict validation were used.
All existing populated filings and manual overrides remain unchanged. Protected SK/AB profiles and baseline files remain unchanged.
Printed source differences of $1 in Long Plain and Gambler are retained and documented; no amount was changed to force reconciliation.
The explicit sourceNullFields marker preserves reviewed blank/dash values through normalization and replay. It has no effect on existing unmarked records.
Source document classifications were not changed. Beardy’s exchanged-link correction remains a separate protected proposal.
